nodes.name: Basic Mechanism
nodes.hint: This item is the first step into automating everything!!!! Really a giant milestone.

nodes.name: Upgrade Base
nodes.hint: Planks -> Press -> Upgrade Base

nodes.name: Andesite Alloy
nodes.hint: Mixing 1 piece of tuff and 1 iron nugget will give you tuff alloy.

nodes.name: Cogwheel
nodes.hint: Deploying planks on shafts will create cogs.

nodes.name: Shaft
nodes.hint: Place the tuff alloy on a saw to cut it into fine shafts.

nodes.name: Oak Planks
nodes.hint: Stripped Log -> Saw -> Planks

nodes.name: Stripped Oak Log
nodes.hint: Log -> Saw -> Stripped Log

nodes.name: Oak Log
nodes.hint: For this you will need saws, deployers, and some rotational force.

nodes.name: Iron Nugget
nodes.hint: Wash the gravel to get this shiny nugget.

nodes.name: Gravel
nodes.hint: Dropping cobble into a millstone will result in gravel.

nodes.name: Cobblestone
nodes.hint: Using drills, water and lava you can automate the gathering of cobblestone, which is one of the most used resources.

nodes.name: Tuff
nodes.hint: Mix cobble and gray dye in a basin mixer. Then... ta-da!

nodes.name: Flint
nodes.hint: Burning gravel will leave you with only the flint left.

nodes.name: Gray Dye
nodes.hint: Crush some flint to get this fine paste.

nodes.name: Molten Copper
nodes.hint: Melt the copper nuggets in a basin foundry.

nodes.name: Cogwheel
nodes.hint: Cogwheels are the backbone of automation.

nodes.name: Copper Nugget
nodes.hint: Wash the orange sand to get copper nuggets.

nodes.name: Orange Sand
nodes.hint: Mix orange dye and sand in a basin.

nodes.name: Orange Dye
nodes.hint: Crushing the granite will give you orange dye.

nodes.name: Sand
nodes.hint: Crushing gravel will give you sand, either via a millstone or curshing wheels.

nodes.name: Granite
nodes.hint: Pour the molten quartz over the andesite (in a basin) and mix until granite comes out.

nodes.name: Nether Quartz
nodes.hint: Washing the soul sand will give you nether quartz and gold nuggets.

nodes.name: Molten Nether Quartz
nodes.hint: Melt quartz in a basin foundry. For info, ponder the basin foundry lid.

nodes.name: Soul Sand
nodes.hint: Haunting sand will make it spooky!!! D;

nodes.name: Diorite
nodes.hint: Pour the molten quartz over the cobblestone (in a basin) and mix until diorite comes out.

nodes.name: Andesite
nodes.hint: Pour the molten quartz over the diorite (in a basin) and mix until andesite comes out.

nodes.name: Molten Steel
nodes.hint: Mix the molten iron and the coal to get molten steel.

nodes.name: Steel Plate
nodes.hint: Press the steel ingots.

nodes.name: Steel Ingot
nodes.hint: Pour the molten steel into a basin and smash it with a mechanical press.

nodes.name: Molten Iron
nodes.hint: Melt iron nuggets in a foundry basin.

nodes.name: Coal
nodes.hint: Compacting black sand will smash it completely and only leave coal.

nodes.name: Cobbled Deepslate
nodes.hint: Haunting tuff will give you cobbled deepslate.

nodes.name: Black Sand
nodes.hint: Mix blackstone and flint to get this fine dust.

nodes.name: Blackstone
nodes.hint: Haunting cobbled deeplsate will give you blackstone.

nodes.name: Brass Sheet
nodes.hint: Press the brass bar flat.

nodes.name: Brass Nugget
nodes.hint: Crush or mill the brass ingots. Or autocraft the nuggets.

nodes.name: Electron Tube
nodes.hint: Pour the destabilized redstone onto the iron sheet.

nodes.name: Brass Ingot
nodes.hint: Press the molten brass in a basin.

nodes.name: Molten Brass
nodes.hint: Mix molten copper and molten zinc in a basin.

nodes.name: Molten Zinc
nodes.hint: Melt the zinc in a foundry basin.

nodes.name: Zinc Nugget
nodes.hint: Haunting iron nuggets will give you zinc nuggets.

nodes.name: Iron Sheet
nodes.hint: Smash that iron. >:D

nodes.name: Iron Ingot
nodes.hint: Compacting molten iron will give you iron ingots.

nodes.name: Destabilized Redstone
nodes.hint: Melt the polished rose quartz in a foundry basin.

nodes.name: Polished Rose Quartz
nodes.hint: Wash the rose quartz, or use sandpaper, your choice.

nodes.name: Rose Quartz
nodes.hint: Mix redstone and quartz in a basin.

nodes.name: Redstone Dust
nodes.hint: Blasting cinder flour will give you this more refined dust.

nodes.name: Cinder Flour
nodes.hint: Milling or crushing netherrack will give you cinder flour.

nodes.name: Netherrack
nodes.hint: Mix lava and cobblestone.

nodes.name: Lava
nodes.hint: There are lots of ways to automate lava, one of the easier ones is using dripstones and cauldrons.

nodes.name: Gem Dust
nodes.hint: Pouring liquid experience over glowstone dust will give this gem.

nodes.name: Magma Cream
nodes.hint: HOT SLIME!?!??!?!?

nodes.name: Bottle o' Enchanting
nodes.hint: Place a absorption hopper next to a mob farm, it will auto collect the xp and output it into a tank. Or use a disenchanter with nuggets of experience.

nodes.name: Slimeball
nodes.hint: Dough + lime dye?????

nodes.name: Glowstone Dust
nodes.hint: CRUSH CRUSH CRUSH CRUSH

nodes.name: Lime Dye
nodes.hint: Crushing or milling the kelp makes lime dye.

nodes.name: Kelp
nodes.hint: Rotation + harvester + water = kelp

nodes.name: Dough
nodes.hint: Washing the flour will give you dough.

nodes.name: Wheat Flour
nodes.hint: Crushing wheat gives you its flour.

nodes.name: Wheat
nodes.hint: Rotation + harvester = wheat

nodes.name: Glowstone
nodes.hint: Pour molten nether quartz over soul sand.

nodes.name: Molten Desh
nodes.hint: Melt the nuggets.

nodes.name: Desh Plate
nodes.hint: SMASH!!!

nodes.name: Desh Ingot
nodes.hint: Compacting the molten desh will give you its ingot form.

nodes.name: Desh Nugget
nodes.hint: Washing moon sand has a chance of leaving you with desh nuggets.

nodes.name: Moon Sand
nodes.hint: Mill moon cobblestone into sand.

nodes.name: Moon Cobblestone
nodes.hint: Look at the recipe for this in JEI. Make a cobble gen with a desh block underneath.

nodes.name: Sulfur Dust
nodes.hint: Crushing wheels

nodes.name: Sulfur
nodes.hint: Cycled around from the heavy oil

nodes.name: Oil
nodes.hint: Heated mixing

nodes.name: Sulfuric Heavy Oil
nodes.hint: Heated mixing of oil and water Produced at the same time as the light oil

nodes.name: Light Oil
nodes.hint: Heated mixing of oil and water Produced at the same time as the sulfuric heavy oil

nodes.name: Heavy Oil
nodes.hint: Heated basin compacting

nodes.name: Refined Fuel
nodes.hint: mix solid fuel with light oil

nodes.name: Solid Fuel Clump
nodes.hint: Compacting Heavy Oil

nodes.name: Small Connector
nodes.hint: Mix all the ingredients in a basin.

nodes.name: Capacitor
nodes.hint: Mechanical crafters are your friends now.

nodes.name: Alternator
nodes.hint: UNLIMITED POWER!!! Literally... this turns rotation into electricity.

nodes.name: Zinc Sheet
nodes.hint: Smashing ingots give you their sheet form.

nodes.name: Copper Sheet
nodes.hint: Holy sheet!

nodes.name: Redstone Torch
nodes.hint: Pour destabilized redstone over the sticks.

nodes.name: Stick
nodes.hint: Cut the wood even more.

nodes.name: Copper Rod
nodes.hint: Rolling ingots give you rods.

nodes.name: Iron Rod
nodes.hint: Rolling ingots give you rods.

nodes.name: Copper Spool
nodes.hint: Deploy the wires onto the empty spools.

nodes.name: Zinc Ingot
nodes.hint: Compact liquid = Ingot

nodes.name: Copper Wire
nodes.hint: Snip snip, rolling sheets give you wires.

nodes.name: Empty Spool
nodes.hint: Nugget + bing bang boom = Spool

nodes.name: Copper Ingot
nodes.hint: Compact liquid = Ingot

nodes.name: Gold Nugget
nodes.hint: Place the tesla coil over a conveyor belt or a depot with a brass nugget underneath and then give the tesla coil power.

nodes.name: Tesla Coil
nodes.hint: You will need this item, not automated though.

nodes.name: Ostrum Fluid Pipe
nodes.hint: Pour molten ostrum over a pipe, or make them in mechanical crafters.

nodes.name: Molten Ostrum
nodes.hint: Melt the ostrum ingots in a foundry basin.

nodes.name: Ostrum Nugget
nodes.hint: Putting mars sand into a centrifugal seperator will spin in until it hardens into ostrum nuggets.

nodes.name: Mars Sand
nodes.hint: Milling or crushing mars cobblestone.

nodes.name: Mars Cobblestone
nodes.hint: Place a block of ostrum under a cobble gen to generate moon cobble.

nodes.name: Fuel
nodes.hint: Put the oil in a fuel refinery.

nodes.name: Oxygen
nodes.hint: Water in an oxygen loader.

nodes.name: Fan
nodes.hint: Same as the engine frame, just different recipe.

nodes.name: Engine Frame
nodes.hint: Mechanical crafting, steel rods + steel plates.

nodes.name: Steel Rod
nodes.hint: Put the steel plates in a rolling mill to get steel rods.

nodes.name: Fluid Pipe
nodes.hint: You already have the required items automated, just put them in a mechanical crafter.

nodes.name: Master Infusion Crystal
nodes.hint: This wont need to be automated, since its unbreakable.
